module: Table of predefined cross-section profiles for the Track Builder: side walls, tilted walls and tubes. Each profile is a table {crossPoints, cap, uv, material, flipUVRight, [sharp]} meant to be extruded along a track segment. All use the 'track_editor_border' material. The file returns the table directly (no M); the names indicate the size: sideWall10 = 1 m high, tube5m = 5 m radius.
notes: createSideWall(height, angle): 3-point profile; angle (rad, 0 by default) tilts the wall. sideWallNN: height NN/10 m (01 = 0.1 m, 10 = 1 m, 50 = 5 m, 100 = 10 m). rotWallNN: height 2 m, tilt of NN degrees.

createTube(radius, steps, wallHeight): circular-arc profile (steps segments) of radius radius, with a thickness of 1 m. The 'High' variants have a taller wall; 'Full' (20 steps, no wall) makes a complete tube.
The tube wall is added only if wallHeight > 0 and steps == 10.
Field types are inferred from the code: each one is a profile table.

tube5m.desc: Tube of radius 5 m with a 1 m wall.

tube5mHigh.desc: Tube of radius 5 m with a 5 m wall.

tube5mFull.desc: Complete tube of radius 5 m (20 steps).

tube10m.desc: Tube of radius 10 m with a 2 m wall.

tube10mHigh.desc: Tube of radius 10 m with a 10 m wall.

tube10mFull.desc: Complete tube of radius 10 m (20 steps).
